name: getCashBenefit
description: Before calling this tool, please call "getSalaryGradeCode" with the salary grade name to get the salary grade code. This tool will be used to get a cash benefit assigned to a salary grade.  We will be able to get the available and allocated cash benefits, as well as the quantity. The user must provide the salary grade name.
